title.zh: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack
title.en: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack

current_state.zh: Binance confirmed a record $6.3 billion hack, and THORChain’s RUNE rose 13% as on-chain investigators traced stolen Binance and Bitget funds through the protocol.
